import json

new_de = {

    "personal_records": {"name": "Persönliche Rekorde"},

    "days_since_workout": {"name": "Days since last workout"},
    "personal_records": {"name": "Personal records"},
    "workout_heart_rate": {"name": "Workout heart rate"},
}
